description: Provider-first routing policy — the Router selects Provider → Model → Agent sequentially

selection_flow.description: Analyze mission intent and extract required capabilities
Select best available provider based on mission capabilities, cost, speed
Within selected provider, pick the best model for the mission
Route to agent best matched to the selected provider + model + mission
